description: T-275: ~1.7 GHz geostationary and polar-orbiter weather satellite imagery (SIGNAL-025 GOES HRIT/EMWIN 1694.1 MHz, SIGNAL-028 Metop/FengYun AHRPT ~1.7 GHz), needs-accessory in docs/use-cases.yaml: a dish plus LNA (bias-tee), not native. Same reused SatDump decoder as plugins/satdump-137 (T-275) behind hk-plugin-satdump - the tiering is antenna/dish requirement, not a different decoder. The `pipeline` param selects SatDump's own pipeline id and is manifest-editable without rebuilding the wrapper; default targets GOES HRIT. See docs/stream-contract.md §9, ADR-0010, ADR-0003.
